content: GamesmanROS: A Generalized Game-Playing Robotic System | EECS at UC Berkeley GamesmanROS: A Generalized Game-Playing Robotic System Nakul Srikanth EECS Department, University of California, Berkeley Technical Report No. UCB/EECS-2025-128 May 22, 2025 http://www2.eecs.berkeley.edu/Pubs/TechRpts/2025/EECS-2025-128.pdf GamesCrafters is a research and development group at UC Berkeley focused on combinatorial game theory and puzzles. Over the past 25 years, it has engaged more than 750 students in the strong solving of abstract strategy games and puzzles through exhaustive search. The group also provides tools for analysis, visualization, and perfect play. This report details the design and implementation of GamesmanROSâan autonomous, game-playing, 6-degree-of-freedom robot that leverages these strongly solved solutions to play over 22 board games and puzzles.
